description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing vector stores in a machine learning or retrieval system, using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, deleting, retrieving info, and updating vector stores, with additional internal functions for resolving embedding configurations from a database based on models. The code integrates with a database via Prisma, handles serialization/deserialization, and interacts with in-memory and registry-stored vector stores.
